annotations.title: Get one hearing and read its transcript

description: One committee hearing or meeting (GET /v1/hearings/{hearing_id}) with its verbatim transcript where one exists (has_transcript in list_hearings; NY public hearings and FL committee meetings carry them). Transcripts can exceed a million characters, so this returns a window of the text (offset, max_chars, next_offset to keep reading) or, with search, every passage that mentions a phrase. transcript_url is the official document. Find hearing_id with list_hearings or get_committee include:['hearings'].

max_chars.description: How many transcript characters to return (default 30000, max 60000).

offset.description: Character offset to start reading the transcript from (default 0). Use next_offset to continue.

search.description: Instead of a window, return every passage that mentions this phrase (case-insensitive, up to 20), each with its offset. Use it to find what a member said about a topic or bill.
